text:
STI-111FP-BT	STI-111FP-BT
Product Name	2 port 10/100Mbps Industrial PoE Switch
Fixed Port	1*10/100M RJ45 PoE port / 1*100M integrated optical port (optional 1310/1550)
PoE Ports	1 port supports IEEE802.3af/at, with a maximum power of 30W per port
PoE Dog	Support
PoE Pin	12+ 45+ 36- 78-
Bandwidth	1Gbps
Packet Forwarding	0.3Mpps
MAC	1K
Buffer	768K
Transmission Distance	10BASE-T: Cat3,4,5 UTP(≤250 meter) / 100BASE-TX: Cat5 or later UTP(150 meter)
Optical Media	SFP: 1000M single and multimode optical module, Max distance≤100Km
LED Indicator	PW: power indicator (green) / 1: 10/100M network connection indicator (green) / 2: Optical fiber connection indicator (green) / V1: Main power indicator (green) / V2: slave power indicator (green) / V3: DC power indicator (green) / PoE: PoE connection indicator (orange)
Power	Three groups of independent power input / POE: DC 37-57V
Operating Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+75°C / 10%～90% RH No condensation
Storage Temperature / Humidity	-40°C～+85°C / 5%～95% RH No condensation
Dimension / L*W*H	Device: 100mm*86mm*30mm / Packing Box: 200mm*130mm*40mm
N.W/G.W(Kg)	0.3Kg/0.4Kg
Lightning / Protection Level	6KV 8/20us；8KV ESD electrostatic protection / IP40
Installation	Desktop, Wall, Rack mountable(with mounting hangers)
Certificate	CE-EMC EN55032; CE-LVD EN62368 / FCC Part 15Class B; RoHS
Warranty	3 Years
